# Project Description

This project is an educational website for sharing homework assignments and coding exercises with students. Students can browse assignments and access their instructions and downloadable materials through the portal.

## Project Structure

- [`assignments/`](../assignments/) Each homework assignment is stored in its own subfolder with a consistent structure.
- [`templates/`](../templates/) Reusable templates for new content.
- [`assets/`](../assets/) Website assets, including CSS, JavaScript, and images.
- [`pages/`](../pages/) Additional website pages, including the assignment detail page.
- [`index.html`](../index.html) The main page for browsing assignments. Assignment listings and course details are configured in [`config.json`](../config.json) at the project root.

## Project Guidelines

- Maintain consistent styling across all pages.
- Keep file and folder names descriptive and organized.

## Educational Standards

When generating content for this project:

- **Learning-focused:** Design content around clear learning objectives and appropriate difficulty levels.
- **Student-friendly:** Use clear, encouraging language that motivates students.
